registry.preferred_name: Anastrozole-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema
support_spans: Patient had undergone left-sided mastectomy 2.5 years prior and had been on anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Right eye showed trace conjunctival injection without definite ciliary flush, 2+ fine keratic precipitates, and 1+ cells in the anterior chamber
Dilated fundus examination revealed cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea in the right eye
Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT):  Image Title: OCT Scans  Image Description: Right eye showed significant cystoid macular edema and subfoveal fluid
